title: Copolymer latex for rubber and fiber adhesives
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a copolymer latex having a small adhesive strength after heat treatment and having a good adhesive force between rubber (particularly ethylene-propylene rubber) and fiber.   SOLUTION: A copolymer latex obtained by emulsion polymerization of 70 to 100% by weight of an aliphatic conjugated diene and 0 to 30% by weight of another monomer copolymerizable therewith, the copolymer latex 10 to 90 parts by weight (in terms of solid content) of a copolymer latex (A) having a toluene insoluble content of 0 to 60% and a weight average particle size of 50 to 350 nm and an aliphatic conjugated diene of 60 to 80% by weight. From 10 to 90 parts by weight (in terms of solid content) of copolymer latex (B) obtained by emulsion polymerization of 5 to 20% by weight of vinylpyridine and 0 to 35% by weight of other monomers copolymerizable therewith (However, the total of (A) and (B) is 100 parts by weight) Copolymer latex for rubber and fiber adhesive.   [Selection figure] None
